title: Diversity scenes v1
description: Sealed boxes of water pushed by one moving, pulsing forcing blob: 40 forcing groups, each at up to six cell densities from 8 to 100 cells per metre, grids up to 128 cubed. Splits are by forcing group. The reserved scenes have never been simulated. The scene table is surrogate/datasets/definitions/diversity-v1.json. The command simulates the train and development scenes one after another on one CPU thread and writes them under diversity-v1/ in the output directory. Reserved scenes are for final checks only and are not generated here (surrogate.datasets generate needs --include-reserved for them).
